note: Measured rmsh BRep -> volume-mesh half bridge (rmsh_algo::Delaunay3D). Volume is also checked against the analytic value in the test; tet_count is an exact pin and the quality fields are regression bands. Re-bless with RMSH_BRIDGE_BLESS=1.

notes.box_unit: Planar faces, so the tetrahedralization conserves the volume exactly.
notes.cylinder_r1_h2: A coarse angular deflection (0.8 rad) trades volume accuracy for a sliver-free mesh; the caps are planar and the lateral surface chordal.
notes.sphere_r1: The lat-long boundary triangulation's pole fan limits min_dihedral; the mesher respects the boundary, so the pole tets stay thin. The angular deflection is the accuracy/quality knob.
